blocks.text: It could have been eight. Philippine Olympic Committee president Bambol Tolentino stood by his gold forecast for Team Philippines at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, saying a series of close calls showed the ambitious target was within reach even after the country finished with four gold medals.
